crash.title: Something went wrong
crash.body: The screen could not be drawn. Your game is safe: it is saved as you play, and Continue on the title screen picks it up from there.
ageGate.title: Adults only
ageGate.body: This game contains sexual content and adult themes, and is for adults only. By going on you confirm that you are 18 years of age or older.
ageGate.fiction: All characters in this game are fictional and are over the age of 18. Any resemblance to real people, living or dead, is coincidental.
interfaceTour.welcome: Before you go, {name}, let me show you around. It'll only take a minute.
interfaceTour.societies: These are the student societies. Each one meets for an hour a week after classes. You can join up to {most} at the Societies Fair, or any time after.
belowTour.wayDown: Whenever you're here at {place}, this is the way down. Open it.
interfaceTour.phone: First, your phone. You'll use it more than anything else. Go ahead and open it.
interfaceTour.chats: These are your messages. When someone gives you her Bloomr contact, you can text her here. She'll reply when she's free, and sometimes she'll text you first. To get a girl's contact, ask her for it, in so many words, while you're talking to her.
interfaceTour.friends: This is everyone you've met, plus anything you've found out about them.
interfaceTour.updates: This is the feed, where people post photos. Like the ones you enjoy. They'll notice.
interfaceTour.jobs: This is where you find work. A job is the main way to make money, and you'll need money for gifts, dates and rent. If you meet a job's requirements, you're hired on the spot, and you get paid after every shift.
interfaceTour.shop: And this is the market. You can buy gifts here and have them delivered.
interfaceTour.map: Now put the phone away and open the map.
interfaceTour.mapPin: This is the map. It shows who's where right now. If you want to talk to someone, find her here and go to her.
interfaceTour.bagGrid: This is your bag. Anything you buy, get given or make ends up here, and you use it from here too.
interfaceTour.relics: Relics go here. You can only find them by adventuring under the University. Each one gives you a permanent bonus.
interfaceTour.calendarSheet: This is your calendar. It shows your classes, work shifts, dates and any events coming up.
interfaceTour.help: If you ever want to know how something works, or more about this world, check Help.
interfaceTour.last: One more thing: what you can do with your day.
belowTour.facts: How long a trip takes out of your day, how many anchors you've set, the relics you've brought back, and how many can come with you.
belowTour.depths: Each depth has an anchor at the bottom. Set it and the next depth opens. You can always go back to one you've cleared: the arrows pick among them.
belowTour.party: Who comes with you. Each of them has a part to play: a guard holds the line, a healer keeps you standing, a hexer spoils what's coming. She has to trust you enough to follow you down, and a mother-to-be hits a great deal harder.
belowTour.partyActions: Pick your company, then go down. It takes a few hours, however it ends.
belowTour.practice: Rather than talk you through the rest, I'll show you. A practice round, just you and me. Nothing down here is real yet.
belowTour.ourParty: That's us. You, and whoever you brought.
belowTour.foes: And that's what the Bloom made. The bar is how much fight it has left. Under it, what it's about to do.
belowTour.status: How much each of us can take before we go down. Lose everyone and the trip is over, and you come up with only what you'd made safe.
belowTour.energy: Your own energy. What you do in a fight costs some, so don't spend it all on the first thing you meet.
belowTour.surge: This is the part to watch. The Bloom builds in us while we work. Let it fill and it spills over. Ground it before then: that's your job.
belowTour.menu: Your turn. Pick Attack, then pick what to hit.
belowTour.way: The stops on the way to the anchor: fights, things left lying around, a dry ledge to rest on. Turn back whenever you like, but you only keep what you'd made safe.
belowTour.farewell: That's all there is to it, sugar. Bring company you trust, mind the Bloom, and come back up in one piece.
preview.noWalker: Nobody called "{who}" has a walking profile
preview.lanternFirst: I wrote my wish before you asked me. You can guess what it was.
preview.lanternSecond: Mine's going higher than hers. Watch.
preview.tripFirst: I've always wanted to try the hot springs. Four whole days!
preview.tripSecond: Save me the window seat on the way back, at least.
modelField.idle: Fill in the base URL to load the available models.
modelField.none: The endpoint lists no models. Type the name.
modelField.failed: Could not load models; type the name. {error}
settings.mainHint: Used for all scenes and memory summaries by default.
settings.nsfwHint: Used for scenes marked NSFW. Leave blank to use the Main LLM for those too.
settings.title: Settings
settings.endpointHint: Each LLM is an OpenAI-compatible endpoint. The base URL is everything before {path}, for example {example}.
settings.keySaved: Saved. Leave blank to keep it.
settings.reasoningStyleTitle: How the endpoint is told: reasoning_effort for OpenAI and most hosted APIs, reasoning for OpenRouter, enable_thinking for a local model's chat template. Auto goes by the address.
settings.allowFallbacks: Allow other providers when these cannot answer
settings.instructionsPlaceholder: Appended to every system prompt sent to this LLM
saves.overwriteDetail: The game saved there is replaced by this one.
title.aboutTip: Told to everyone you meet, after the lines above. Write {token} for your name.
title.randomizeTip: Spend the whole pool at random
title.noCatalogue: The game's course catalogue is missing, so a new game cannot start.
title.staleCatalogue: The course catalogue was built before the characters last changed. Build it again under Edit game content, Courses.
title.autosaveReplaced: The autosave will be replaced as soon as you act in the new game. Saves in numbered slots are kept.
help.belowSurge: A surge builds half as fast
help.belowGrounding: Ground clears all of a surge
help.belowSteady: A hex on your party lasts half as long
help.belowInsight: Shows what each enemy is weak to
help.title: Help
help.termLength: The game runs for one term of {days} days. When the last day ends, the epilogue tells what became of you.
help.termHours: Everything you do takes whole hours. Classes, shifts and plans happen at set hours whether you turn up or not.
help.termFocus: Pick a Focus on the day screen, under who is here: when you skip ahead to your next class, shift or plan, the hours in between are spent on it, at half the rate of a session and for no energy.
help.termSleep: Midnight to 06:00 is for sleep. End the day skips to 06:00 the next morning with full energy.
help.dayMapDoes: The town, with who is at each place beside it. Press Go on a place to walk there.{below, select, true { Once you know of it, the way down into {name} glows.} other {}}
help.dayPhoneDoes: Friends, messages, the photo feed, the jobs board and the market.
help.dayCalendarDoes: Your week by the hour, or the month. Press anything on it to read about it; a class shows who is in it.
help.dayBagDoes: What you carry, what you can make, and the relics you hold.
help.dayHouseDoes: Your house, once you have one.
help.scenesOpen: Doing something with someone opens a scene. You type; she answers in her own voice.
help.scenesEnd: She decides when a scene ends, and can leave early if she is uncomfortable.
help.scenesScroll: Scroll up over the text box to go back to an earlier turn and say something else.
help.scenesStop: While she is answering, the stop button beside the text box halts it.
help.scenesSummary: When a scene ends, a summary shows how her feelings changed and what she will remember.
help.talkIntro: Nearly everything between you and a woman is settled in what is said. There are no buttons for it: ask, offer, suggest, and she answers as herself.
help.contactKnow: You cannot message her without it. She may refuse or put you off if she barely knows you, and offers it unasked once she is taken with you.
help.knowKnow: Her likes, dislikes, nature and what she is drawn to fill in on her phone profile as they come out.
help.secretsKnow: Each has its own condition, such as a stage or enough trust. Until then she deflects, however you ask.
help.againHow: Agree a day and a time.
help.againKnow: It goes on your calendar. Stand her up and she loses {affection} affection and {trust} trust, and remembers it.
help.goKnow: If she agrees, the scene moves there and carries on, and the clock moves with it.
help.eventKnow: If she says she will be there, she is there when you go.
help.bondHow: Raise it, or wait for her to.
help.bondKnow: She proposes an arrangement; you accept or decline. Each needs a stage first.
help.controlKnow: It is her decision. She may also decide it on her own.
help.nightKnow: If the scene ends with the two of you falling asleep, you wake there in the morning, rested.
help.readingEnd: She decides when a scene is over, and says goodbye in her own way.
help.readingPress: Press her on something she does not want and she grows uneasy, changes the subject, and in the end leaves. Easing off brings her back.
help.readingClass: A class she has to get to pulls her away too.
help.readingGift: Give a gift from the Bag button in a scene. She reacts on the spot, and a gift she loves or hates tells you something about her.
help.betweenMessage: Message anyone whose Bloomr you have from the phone. She answers when she is free, and may write to you first.
help.betweenInvites: Invitations arrive as messages: accept one and it is on your calendar.
help.betweenFeed: What she posts on her feed is hers to mention, and yours to like.
help.statsSix: Six stats: strength, dexterity, endurance, intelligence, charisma, wisdom. 10 is ordinary; the cap is 30.
help.statsRise: They rise through work on them: classes, the Stats option on the day screen, and shifts at a job that builds one.
help.statsSlow: A day's work on one stat counts less after the first few points, so stats are built over weeks. They never fall.
help.statsJobsHow: Better jobs require higher stats, and pay a bonus for every point over the requirement.
help.statsAppealHow: Each woman admires up to three stats. The higher yours are, the faster her affection grows.
help.statsStudyHow: Studying in your room earns more; a study at home adds to it.
help.coursesClass: Every class has one or two women you can know in it, counting the teacher: sitting it is a scene with them.
help.coursesPoints: Each course has 100 points to earn over the term: attending class earns most, studying earns the rest.
help.coursesExams: Midterms and finals replace a class in their week, and ask about the classes you sat.
help.coursesGrades: 80% of the marks is a B and 60% a C. Every answer right lifts either by a letter. Under 60%, or not turning up, is an F.
help.societiesMeet: Student clubs, each meeting for {hours, plural, =1 {an hour} other {# hours}} once a week after classes. They open at {fair}; join or leave them on the phone after that.
help.societiesMost: You can belong to {most} at a time, and not two that meet at the same hour. A meeting can clash with a shift.
help.societiesFair: At the fair, every student is at one of her society's tables. Saying hello costs nothing and counts as meeting her; stopping to talk takes an hour. Each table gives something away the first time you stop.
help.societiesScene: A meeting is a scene with the students in it, and trains what the society is about, like a short class with no marks.
help.skillsTaught: Every course teaches one thing once you have enough marks in it, for as long as you stay enrolled.
help.skillsKinds: Some let you see something about a woman. Some change a number for good: wages, rent, how fast trust grows.
help.skillsAbilities: Some let you make or set off something, then wait days to do it again. Find those in your Bag, on the day screen or behind the Bag button in a scene.
help.skillsBrews: What you brew is an item: drink it yourself, or use it on the woman you are with. The Bag shows what is in effect and for how long.
help.belowNone: There is nothing under the University in this game.
help.belowFromDay: From day {day} someone asks to meet you at {place}. It cannot be put off: once it is next on your day, it is all there is to do.
help.belowGoDownAfter: is offered there. A run takes {hours} hours of your day, however it ends.
help.belowParty: Pick a depth you have opened and up to {most} women. She must have met you, trust you ({trust}), be free for those hours, and not be about to give birth.
help.runFightDoes: Beat what is there to pick up what it was guarding.
help.runFindDoes: Something lying about: picked up as you pass.
help.runCheckpointDoes: What you have found so far is made safe, and everyone gets back {n}% of their footing.
help.runGuardianDoes: The last fight. Win it and you set the anchor.
help.runAnchor: Setting an anchor for the first time gives you its relic and opens the next depth. There are {n}.
help.runTurnBack: Turning back keeps only what was made safe at a checkpoint.
help.runLose: Losing keeps the same, leaves you with no energy for the day, and costs the trust of whoever went down.
help.runRemember: Whoever came remembers it, and a win raises her trust.
help.fightOrder: You act first, then each woman, then the enemies. Without the right course, they get a free blow about half the time as a fight begins.
help.fightFooting: Footing is health. At none she is down until the fight is over.
help.fightWard: A ward shows as a blue band on everyone's footing: it takes the next hits meant for any of you.
help.fightEnergy: The blue bar under your footing is energy, the same energy as above ground.
help.fightAffection: Her affection makes her strike true more often, for half as much again.
help.turnAttackDoes: Hits one enemy. Stronger with strength.
help.turnProtectDoes: The next hit meant for her lands on you, and less of it for your endurance.
help.turnEmpowerDoes: Her next action is about {n}% stronger, more with wisdom. {energy} energy.
help.turnGroundDoes: Takes {n} off a pregnant woman's surge. {energy} energy.
help.turnItemDoes: Something from your bag that works below.
help.pregnancyPower: A woman who is carrying does more: {list}.
help.pregnancySurge: Each thing she does adds to her surge, the orange bar under her footing. At {limit} it breaks loose: {misfire} from everyone, through any ward.
help.pregnancyGround: Ground her, or use something that clears a surge, before it fills. Defending and taunting add nothing to it.
help.meetSweepsMeans: It hits all of you at once, for less each.
help.meetHexesMeans: Its hit leaves her doing less for a couple of rounds.
help.meetFalteringMeans: Weakened by a hexer: it hits less hard for now.
help.meetWeakMeans: One role does half as much again to it. Shown only with the right course.
help.upRelics: Relics are kept for good and are listed in your Bag. Each changes a number of the game, as a course skill does.
help.upMoney: Money, and things to use in a fight, are yours once made safe.
help.feelingsAffectionFor: Sets the stage of the relationship.
help.feelingsTrustFor: What she will tell you and agree to.
help.feelingsDesireFor: Whether she will go to bed with you.
help.feelingsRange: Each runs from 0 to {max}. They change only when a scene ends, by up to 10 either way, as she judges the scene. Gifts also raise affection.
help.bondsAsk: She asks, or you raise it in a scene; you accept or decline.
help.bondsJealous: A woman with a claim on you may turn up in the middle of a scene with someone else. Jealous women do it more.
help.memoriesOne: She keeps one short memory of each scene, rated {levels}. You can edit both on the summary screen.
help.memoriesRecall: In a scene she recalls at most eight: the most important first, then the most recent.
help.willEasyTakes: Nothing: she may on the day you meet.
help.willDesire: Not the day you meet, and desire of {n} or more.
help.willSettled: It is settled when the scene starts. A scene that begins too early stays that way however well it goes.
help.willSkill: With the right skill, her profile on the phone shows how much desire is still needed.
help.conceiveChance: Chance each day you finish inside her
help.conceivePeriod: On her period ({days} days in every {cycle})
help.conceiveStart: Most women start on birth control. She stops when she chooses to: ask her in a scene, or she may decide it herself.
help.conceiveSkills: With the right skills, her profile shows whether she is on it, and when she is on her period. See Stats and study.
help.conceiveLength: A pregnancy lasts {days} days. She cannot conceive again for {recovery} days after a birth.
help.birthNotice: {days} days before she is due, the hour is set, it goes on your calendar and she messages you. It cannot be moved.
help.birthThere: Be there: the birth is a scene, she suggests a name, and you may choose another.
help.birthMiss: Miss it: the child is born anyway, she names it, and she takes a heavy and lasting loss of affection, trust and desire.
help.houseOffer: Once a woman you have an arrangement with is carrying your child, the Sire Relations Office messages you an offer.
help.houseViewing: Accept, and the housing officer sets an hour to show you round. It goes on your calendar; if you miss it she sets another.
help.houseYours: The house is yours once you have been shown it. It replaces your room in the Halls, and a live-in nanny comes with it.
help.costRentAmount: ${rent}, less ${perChild} a child, to no less than ${floor}
help.costChildWhen: The first day of each week
help.costGrace: Rent unpaid for {days} days loses the house for good: everyone goes home and the children go to the creche.
help.roomsBedsFor: Each bed lets one woman move in.
help.roomsCotsFor: Each cot lets one child live at home.
help.roomsComfortFor: Sets how well children can do.
help.roomsStudyFor: Adds to what studying at home earns.
help.moveWho: A woman who is carrying your child or has borne one, has an arrangement with you, and has affection of {n} or more. Pick a bedroom in the house and offer it to her.
help.moveLeave: Asked to leave, she does not forgive it and does not come back.
help.childrenLowest: Lowest: she leaves with the child
help.childrenHome: A child lives at home when its mother does and a cot is free. Otherwise it is at the creche, which costs nothing.
help.childrenPaid: A week paid for: the child goes up a level, as far as the house's comfort allows.
help.childrenUnpaid: A week not paid for: it drops a level and its mother thinks less of you.
help.jobsBoard: The Jobs board is on the phone. You hold one job at a time, and are taken on at once if you meet its requirements.
help.jobsShift: A shift is a scene at the workplace. It costs {energy} energy an hour and pays when it ends.
help.jobsQuit: A job you quit or lose will not take you back.
help.jobsBonusHow: +{bonus} pay for each point over a job's requirements, up to +{cap}. Jobs with no requirements pay no bonus.
help.jobsMissedHow: {strike} strike, or {excused} if you messaged your boss that day beforehand.
help.spendingGifts: Gifts from the market and shops change affection: up for something she likes, more for something she loves, down for something she dislikes.
help.spendingScene: What you spend during a scene is settled when it ends.
help.spendingHouse: The house is the main thing to save for: rent, the children's keep, and every room.
help.cardsTable: {name} at {place}: Texas hold'em with whoever is there, ${small}/${big}, and no more than ${cap} in a hand.
app.missedPlan: You missed {plan} with {who}, and sent no word. It will be remembered.
app.feedNoComfy: Today's posts could not be made: ComfyUI did not answer. {message}
app.feedUnwritten: {missing} of {total} posts could not be written.
app.feedUndrawn: A picture could not be drawn: {error}.
app.feedSome: Some of today's posts could not be made. {failed}
app.feedFailed: Today's posts could not be made. {message}
app.tookNobody: You took nobody to {event}. {who} {count, plural, one {is} other {are}} hurt.
app.birthMissed: {mother} gave birth to your {daughter, select, true {daughter} other {son}}, {child}, and you were not there. She will not forget it.
app.stoppedControl: {who} {count, plural, one {has} other {have}} stopped taking birth control.
app.photoFailed: The picture could not be taken. {error}
app.notAsked: {who} {count, plural, one {is hurt you did not ask her} other {are hurt you did not ask them}}.
app.focusToast: Focus: {focus} · {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}}
app.classDirection: You are in class together. The lecture runs its course as you talk and is over by the time on the clock, so by the end of this scene everyone is free to leave: to walk back to a room, or go on somewhere.
app.nobodyCame: Nobody you know came to {society} tonight.
app.nightDirection: This is {event}, a night of {society}, which {player} has joined. {direction} Everyone here is willing tonight; how far it goes is up to {player}.
app.meetingDirection: This is the weekly meeting of {society}, which {player} has joined; it runs for an hour, and by the end of this scene it is over and everyone is free to go.{tonight, select, true { Tonight: {topic}} other {}}
app.fairTableActivity: Stopping at the {society} table at the Societies Fair
app.fairTableDirection: It is the Societies Fair. {who} {count, plural, one {is} other {are}} at the {society} table, signing up new members, and {player} has stopped to talk. It lasts about an hour.
app.fairDirection: It is the Societies Fair, and {player} has stopped to talk. It lasts about an hour.
app.paid: You were paid ${pay} for your shift{extra, select, true {, {bonus}% of it over the rate for your stats} other {}}.
app.partingBloomr: {who} gave you {count, plural, one {her} other {their}} Bloomr before you parted.
app.wrongGuess: It was {who}. She is hurt you did not know her.
app.endDayBody: You turn in and sleep until 06:00 tomorrow. Anything still to come today is let go.
app.lastPrompt: System prompt sent for the last message
